control.title: Business continuity and disaster recovery
control.description: Maintain a business continuity and DR plan with RTO and RPO targets, keep security in place during disruption, and test the plan annually.

acceptance_criteria: A business continuity and disaster recovery plan with recovery objectives (RTO, RPO)
A test of the plan in the last 12 months, with results and actions

criteria_coverage.criterion: A business continuity and disaster recovery plan with recovery objectives (RTO, RPO)
A test of the plan in the last 12 months, with results and actions

requirements.title: BCP, DR in another seismic zone, half-yearly drills
requirements.guidance: Scenario-based BCP reviewed annually, RTO/RPO aligned (near-zero RPO aspired), DR site in a different seismic zone, DR drills at least half-yearly.

requirements.title: Incident recovery
requirements.guidance: Recover from incidents and apply lessons learned.

requirements.title: Business disruption
requirements.guidance: Identify and mitigate risks from potential business disruptions.

requirements.title: Continuity of processing and backups
requirements.guidance: Ensure continued processing if confidentiality, integrity or availability is compromised, for example through data backups.

requirements.title: Information security during disruption
requirements.guidance: Maintain security at an appropriate level during disruption.

requirements.title: ICT readiness for business continuity
requirements.guidance: Plan, implement, maintain and test ICT readiness for continuity objectives.

evidence.title: Business Continuity and Disaster Recovery Policy v1 (approved)
evidence.description: Approved by Priya Sharma on 27 Nov 2026.

evidence.title: DR test
evidence.description: We tested failover last quarter and it worked.

checks.message: A note is a statement, not proof. Attach the record, export or screenshot if one exists.

ai_check.summary: A statement that a test happened, without the test record.
issues: Attach the DR test report with the date, scope, RTO achieved and actions.
